items.title: 輝達哪些AI晶片還能賣中國？美國會擬設「落後兩代」門檻 H200剛好踩線
items.title_en: Which Nvidia AI Chips Can Still Be Sold to China? U.S. May Set a “Two‑Generation Lag” Threshold, H200 Hits the Line
paras: 據《彭博》周五(6日)報導，美國國會兩黨正協商一項提案，擬維持現行AI晶片出口限制18個月，期間中國只能取得至少落後美國最先進產品兩個世代的技術。輝達(NVDA-US)已獲准銷往中國的H200，恰好比最新的Rubin系列落後兩代。明年1月民主黨接掌國會後，執行長黃仁勳還可能面對另一道問題：輝達如何確認賣給海外客戶的晶片，最終沒有被轉運到中國？

H200獲准銷中 實際銷量低於核准數量

川普政府於2025年底允許輝達向中國銷售H200，但取得美方許可只是第一關。輝達今年8月向投資人證實，由於北京當局反對，公司僅向中國客戶售出少量H200，實際銷量低於美方核准的數量。
這批許可如何核發，也已引起國會關注。民主黨參議員華倫與眾議院外交委員會民主黨首席議員米克斯，已要求川普政府提供相關資料。華倫也多次要求黃仁勳赴國會說明輝達的中國業務。她是下屆參議院銀行委員會主席熱門人選，若接掌這個負責監督出口管制的委員會，將更有權力要求黃仁勳出席作證。
立法進度可能比國會換屆更快。華倫與共和黨參議員班克斯正爭取在明年1月3日新國會就職前，將上述《AI監督法案》納入國防法案。若獲通過，國會將對AI晶片銷中有更大的監督權。「落後兩代」是提案要維持的技術門檻，個別產品能否出貨，仍涉及出口許可。

晶片賣到東南亞之後 國會擬要求查驗流向

另一項仍在協商的《晶片安全法案》，則把監管重點放在交貨之後。依最新公開版本，美國商務部可決定如何驗證出口至海外的AI資料中心晶片是否遭轉運，例如透過訊號回傳確認晶片位置，或派員到現場清點庫存。
《彭博》引述知情人士指出，輝達已加強追蹤銷往東南亞的AI加速器。新加坡客戶Megaspeed便是一例。三名共和黨籍眾院委員會主席日前要求黃仁勳說明他與該公司一名高層的往來。黃仁勳上周接受《彭博》訪問時表示，輝達已查核Megaspeed部署GPU的情況，逐一清點後，確認該客戶未違法將晶片運往中國。
兩項提案目前都在協商。對輝達而言，前者關係到未來哪些產品還有機會取得對中出口許可，後者則可能使晶片流向查驗成為海外出貨必須符合的要求。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg on Friday the 6th, bipartisan members of the U.S. Congress are negotiating a proposal to keep the current AI chip export restrictions in place for 18 months, during which China would be allowed to obtain only technology that is at least two generations behind the United States' most advanced products. Nvidia (NVDA-US) has been approved to sell its H200 to China, which happens to be two generations behind the latest Rubin series. After Democrats take control of Congress in January, CEO Jensen Huang may face another issue: how Nvidia can ensure that chips sold to overseas customers are not ultimately re‑exported to China.

The Trump administration allowed Nvidia to sell the H200 to China through the end of 2025, but obtaining U.S. permission was only the first hurdle. In August, Nvidia told investors that, because Beijing objected, the company sold only a small number of H200 units to Chinese customers, with actual shipments falling short of the amount approved by the U.S. government.

How the permits were issued has already drawn congressional attention. Democratic Senator Warren and House Foreign Affairs Committee Democratic ranking member Mick Mulvaney have asked the Trump administration for the relevant documentation. Warren has repeatedly called on Jensen Huang to appear before Congress to explain Nvidia’s China business. She is a leading candidate to chair the Senate Banking Committee, which oversees export controls, and would have greater authority to demand Huang’s testimony if she assumes that role.

Legislative progress could outpace the congressional turnover. Warren and Republican Senator Mike Braun are pushing to embed the proposed “AI Oversight Act” into the defense authorization bill before the new Congress is sworn in on Jan. 3. If passed, Congress would gain broader oversight of AI chip sales to China. The “two‑generation lag” is the technical threshold the bill seeks to maintain, while individual product shipments would still require export licenses.

Another bill under negotiation, the “Chip Security Act,” focuses on post‑delivery monitoring. The latest public draft gives the Commerce Department authority to verify whether AI data‑center chips exported abroad are being re‑routed, for example by using signal‑back checks on chip location or by sending personnel to inventory on‑site.

Bloomberg, citing sources, reported that Nvidia has stepped up tracking of AI accelerators shipped to Southeast Asia. Singapore customer Megaspeed is one example. Three Republican chairs of House committees recently asked Jensen Huang to explain his interactions with a senior executive at the firm. Huang told Bloomberg last week that Nvidia has audited Megaspeed’s GPU deployments, counted the units one by one, and confirmed the customer has not illegally shipped the chips to China.

Both proposals are still being negotiated. For Nvidia, the first determines which future products may still qualify for export licenses to China, while the second could make verification of chip destinations a mandatory condition for any overseas shipment.

items.title: AI股若繼續跌 Fed還會升息嗎？「Fed傳聲筒」點出12月關鍵
items.title_en: If AI Stocks Keep Falling, Will the Fed Still Raise Rates? The “Fed Mouthpiece” Highlights a Key December Factor
paras: 聯準會(Fed)12月是否再升息，AI股這波修正可能比剛公布的非農就業數據更值得關注。有「Fed傳聲筒」之稱的《華爾街日報》(WSJ)記者Nick Timiraos周五(6日)分析，近期經濟數據與官員談話仍指向12月再度升息，但若AI股賣壓持續，進一步拖累消費與企業投資，金融市場本身就可能產生部分升息原本要達到的緊縮效果。

AI股跌多久 為什麼跌 都會影響Fed判斷

Timiraos指出，自10月中旬開始的AI股賣壓，在周四(5日)科技股重挫後加深。投資人重新評估AI相關企業的獲利前景，原因之一是晶片、電力等資源短缺，成本上升的速度超過企業向客戶轉嫁的速度，利潤因而受到擠壓。
對Fed而言，跌幅只是判斷的一部分。即使股價短時間內大跌，只要市場很快回穩，官員也可能不會改變利率看法。但若投資人開始懷疑，企業投入的龐大AI支出能否創造足以支撐估值的回報，這波修正就可能持續更久，影響也會從股市延伸到實體經濟。
股價持續下跌，可能削弱家庭財富對消費的支撐。企業若也重新評估AI投資的回報，原本帶動經濟成長的資本支出便可能放慢。在這種情況下，即使Fed維持利率不變，金融環境也已收緊，進一步升息以抑制需求的必要性就會降低。

華許重視市場訊號 下周CPI是決策前最後一份

這也是Timiraos認為市場走勢可能比單月非農數字更重要的原因。Fed主席華許重視金融市場對經濟前景的判斷，對仰賴反映過去狀況的月度統計來決定利率則抱持疑慮。他上任前就曾提醒，政府數據公布有時間落差，事後也經常修正，過度強調「依據數據決策」有其風險。
眼下，12月升息仍是較受支持的方向。Fed在9月升息後，10月將基準利率維持在3.75%至4%，理事庫克與克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克當時都投票支持再升息。會後也有多名官員表示，利率可能仍需逐步調高。10月就業報告大致印證官員原先的判斷：勞動市場供需大致平衡，通膨卻仍高於2%目標。
接下來最值得留意的時間點是11月10日。當天公布的10月消費者物價指數(CPI)，將是Fed在12月8日至9日開會前能看到的最後一份CPI，因為11月數據要到利率決議出爐隔天才公布。屆時官員手上還會多一份就業報告，但在Timiraos看來，物價壓力是否持續，以及AI股修正是否已收緊金融環境，才更可能左右12月的決定。
paras_en: The question of whether the Federal Reserve will raise rates again in December is perhaps more noteworthy than the just‑released non‑farm payroll data, given the ongoing correction in AI stocks. WSJ reporter Nick Timiraos, known as the “Fed mouthpiece,” wrote on Friday (the 6th) that recent economic data and officials’ remarks still point to another December hike, but if AI‑stock selling pressure persists and drags down consumer spending and corporate investment, the financial markets themselves could generate part of the tightening effect that a rate hike is meant to achieve.

Timiraos notes that the AI‑stock sell‑off, which began in mid‑October, deepened after a sharp drop in tech stocks on Thursday (the 5th). Investors are re‑evaluating the profit outlook for AI‑related firms, partly because shortages of chips, electricity and other resources are driving cost increases faster than companies can pass them on to customers, squeezing margins.

For the Fed, the market decline is only one piece of the puzzle. Even if stock prices tumble sharply in the short term, officials may not change their rate view as long as the market stabilises quickly. However, if investors start doubting whether the massive AI spending by companies can generate returns sufficient to justify current valuations, the correction could linger and its impact could spread from the equity market to the real economy.

Continued price declines could erode household wealth support for consumption. If firms also reassess the returns on AI investments, capital spending that had been fueling growth could slow. In that scenario, even if the Fed leaves rates unchanged, the financial environment would already be tighter, reducing the need for further hikes to curb demand.

Timiraos believes market dynamics may matter more than a single month’s payroll numbers. Fed Chair Jerome Powell places great weight on financial‑market signals about the economy’s outlook and is skeptical of relying solely on monthly statistics that reflect past conditions. Before taking office, Powell warned that government data are released with a lag and are often revised, so over‑reliance on “data‑driven” decisions carries risk.

At present, a December rate hike remains the more likely path. After raising rates in September, the Fed kept the target range at 3.75%‑4% in October, with Board members Cook and Cleveland Fed President Mester voting in favor of another increase. Several officials later said rates may still need to be raised gradually. The October jobs report broadly confirmed their view: labor‑market supply and demand were roughly balanced, but inflation stayed above the 2% target.

The most important date to watch is November 10, when the October Consumer Price Index will be released. It will be the last CPI reading the Fed sees before its meeting on December 8‑9, because November’s data won’t be published until the day after the rate decision. Officials will also have an employment report at that time, but Timiraos argues that whether price pressures persist and whether the AI‑stock correction has already tightened financial conditions are more likely to shape the December decision.

items.title: AI股震盪掀避險潮！日元重拾傳統避風港魅力 分析師看好長線升至148
items.title_en: AI Stocks Volatile Sparks Hedging Wave! Yen Reclaims Traditional Safe‑Haven Appeal, Analysts See Long‑Term Rise to 148
paras: 美國期中選舉本周由民主黨大勝後，市場對人工智慧(AI)投資前景的疑慮升高，美國科技股遭遇賣壓，促使投資人轉向較安全的資產，日元兌美元上揚，市場策略師指出，日元正逐漸成為抵禦AI交易衝擊的有效避險工具，並可能重新展現部分傳統避險貨幣的特性。
股市重挫促使投資人轉向避險貨幣之際，日元兌美元周五一度升至一周高點，來到157.27日元，隨後漲幅收斂，亞洲周五下午回落至157.805日元。日元兌美元周四一度升值0.6%，表現優於所有G10貨幣。
分析師指出，匯市正隨著股市與債市走勢起伏，投資人正在評估民主黨贏得美國期中選舉的影響，以及這對AI交易、關稅政策和美國與以色列對伊朗戰爭可能帶來的變化。
最新一波升勢顯示，日元可能正在重拾部分傳統避險貨幣的特性。上個月科技股大跌之際，日元兌美元一度升至156.08日元，隨後回吐大部分漲幅。高盛集團(Goldman Sachs)策略師先前指出，日元正逐漸成為抵禦AI引發市場衝擊的更有效避險工具。

AI交易退潮推升避險需求 日元明年有望升至148

加拿大帝國商業銀行資本市場(CIBC Capital Markets)外匯策略主管Sarah Ying說：「如果AI交易持續退潮，投資人就會開始尋找資金去處。我們認為，避險貨幣的需求將會增加」，其中包括日元與瑞士法郎。
她預期，隨著投資人撤離美元計價的資產，日元到2027年底將升至148，較目前水準升值逾6%。
星展銀行(OCBC)匯市策略師Moh Siong Sim則說，若僅因AI市場疑慮就預期日元持續升值，現在可能還言之過早。
日元在市場動盪作為避險去處的特質近年來逐漸減弱，原因在於美日利差維持高檔，加上日本投資人持續將資金配置於海外，即使市場避險情緒升高，投資人仍傾向賣出日元。
野村國際(Nomura International)G10外匯策略主管Dominic Bunning表示，該公司仍持有日元兌美元多頭部位，並將其稱為在股市與債券殖利率同步下跌環境中「持續表現最佳的外匯交易策略」。
他指出，隨著日本銀行(BOJ，央行)升息，如果日本資產管理機構將更多投資從海外債券市場轉回國內市場，日元也將因此受惠。他預期，日銀進一步升息將有助於延續這波交易趨勢。
日銀下一次政策決議將於12月18日公布。隔夜指數交換(OIS)市場目前反映，屆時升息的機率為76%。

日本資金回流提供支撐 美元避險吸引力反而有限

日本數十年來維持超低利率，促使保險公司、退休基金及其他投資人為追求更高報酬，大舉持有海外資產。隨著日本國內債券殖利率上升，即使投資人沒有直接出售既有海外資產，只要將更多資金留在國內，也可能減少長期以來持續抑制日元的壓力。
宏利投資管理(Manulife Investment Management)資深投資組合經理Nathan Thooft表示：「在股市波動加劇之際，避險需求回歸，日元因此受惠。」
他指出：「美元面臨的問題正好相反：美國優越性有太多部分如今與AI綁在一起，因此只要這套論述出現任何裂痕，很快就可能演變成美元本身的問題。」
paras_en: After the Democrats’ big win in this week’s U.S. midterm elections, market doubts about artificial‑intelligence (AI) investment prospects rose, prompting a sell‑off in U.S. tech stocks. Investors shifted to safer assets, lifting the yen against the dollar. Market strategists say the yen is gradually becoming an effective hedge against AI‑driven market shocks and may once again display some of the traits of a traditional safe‑haven currency.

As equity markets slumped and investors fled to safe‑haven currencies, the yen rose to a weekly high of 157.27 per dollar on Friday before easing back to 157.805 by Friday afternoon in Asia. On Thursday the yen had appreciated 0.6% against the dollar, outperforming all other G10 currencies.

Analysts note that the FX market is moving in step with equity and bond market swings as investors assess the impact of the Democrats’ midterm victory and its possible effects on AI trading, tariff policy and the U.S.–Israel war against Iran.

The latest rally suggests the yen may be regaining some of its traditional safe‑haven characteristics. When tech stocks plunged last month, the yen briefly hit 156.08 per dollar before giving back most of the gain. Goldman Sachs strategists previously warned that the yen is becoming a more effective hedge against AI‑induced market turbulence.

"If AI‑driven trading continues to recede, investors will start looking for places to park capital," said Sarah Ying, head of FX strategy at CIBC Capital Markets. "We expect demand for safe‑haven currencies, including the yen and the Swiss franc, to rise."
She forecasts that as investors pull out of dollar‑denominated assets, the yen will climb to 148 by the end of 2027, a gain of more than 6% from current levels.
OCBC FX strategist Moh Siong Sim cautioned that it may be premature to expect a sustained yen rally solely on AI‑market concerns.

The yen’s role as a safe‑haven haven has weakened in recent years because the U.S.–Japan interest‑rate gap remains high and Japanese investors continue to allocate funds overseas, so even when risk aversion spikes, they tend to sell yen.

Nomura International G10 FX chief Dominic Bunning said the firm still holds a long yen‑dollar position, calling it “the best‑performing FX strategy” in an environment where equities and bond yields are falling together.

He added that if the Bank of Japan raises rates and Japanese asset managers shift more investments from overseas bonds back to domestic markets, the yen would benefit, and further BOJ hikes should sustain the trend.
The BOJ’s next policy decision is slated for Dec. 18, and the overnight index swap market currently puts the probability of a rate hike at 76%.

Japan’s decades‑long ultra‑low rates have pushed insurers, pension funds and other investors to seek higher returns abroad. As domestic bond yields rise, even without selling existing overseas holdings, keeping more capital at home could ease the long‑standing downward pressure on the yen.
Nathan Thooft, senior portfolio manager at Manulife Investment Management, said that heightened equity volatility is reviving hedging demand, which benefits the yen.

He noted that the dollar’s challenges are the opposite: many of America’s perceived advantages are now tied to AI, so any crack in that narrative could quickly turn into a problem for the dollar itself.

items.title: 密大11月消費者信心意外升至51 一年期通膨預期降至4.3%
items.title_en: Michigan November Consumer Confidence Unexpectedly Rises to 51, One-Year Inflation Expectation Falls to 4.3%
paras: 美國11月初消費者信心意外升至三個月高點。密西根大學周五(6日)公布，11月消費者信心指數初值從10月的48升至51，高於經濟學家原估的48。消費者對個人財務與經濟前景的看法略有好轉，但仍有57%的受訪者主動提到，高物價侵蝕了生活水準，對AI可能出現泡沫的憂慮也在升高。
這次調查於10月20日至11月2日進行，全數回覆都在美國期中選舉投票前收集。無黨派受訪者的消費信心升至逾一年來最高，民主黨與共和黨支持者的信心則雙雙下滑。
分項數據顯示，現況指數與預期指數分別升至51及50.9，雙雙創8月以來最高。整體受訪者對自身當前財務狀況的評價升至四個月高點，對是否適合購買耐久財的看法也從歷史低點回升。
不過，物價漲得比薪資快，食品、汽油與住房支出仍擠壓家庭預算。主動提及高物價影響生活水準的受訪者占比創5月以來最高。對未來物價的看法則略有改善：消費者預期未來一年通膨率為4.3%，低於10月的4.7%，創三個月新低。未來5至10年的通膨預期也從3.5%降至3.4%。
近期股市震盪，則讓持股最多的家庭感受不同。密西根大學消費者調查主任Joanne Hsu指出，財富較少及中等的受訪者信心均有改善，持股部位最大的一群人，消費信心卻較上月下滑5%。
這群人對自身財務狀況的評價更下跌12%，降至4月以來最低，可能與近幾周股價波動有關。她也表示，從受訪者的回覆可看出，愈來愈多人擔心AI投資熱潮可能形成泡沫。
paras_en: U.S. consumer confidence in early November unexpectedly rose to a three‑month high. The University of Michigan released on Friday (the 6th) that the preliminary November consumer confidence index jumped from 48 in October to 51, above economists’ forecast of 48. Consumers’ views on personal finances and the economic outlook improved slightly, but 57% of respondents still cited high prices eroding living standards, and concerns that AI could be forming a bubble are growing.

The survey was conducted from October 20 to November 2, with all responses collected before the U.S. midterm elections. Confidence among non‑partisan respondents rose to the highest level in over a year, while confidence among Democrats and Republicans both slipped.

Component data show the current‑conditions index and the expectations index rose to 51 and 50.9 respectively, both hitting their highest levels since August. Overall, respondents rated their present financial situation at a four‑month high, and their view on whether it was a good time to buy durable goods rebounded from a historic low.

However, prices are rising faster than wages, with food, gasoline and housing costs still squeezing household budgets. The share of respondents who voluntarily mentioned high prices affecting living standards hit its highest level since May. Outlook for future prices improved slightly: consumers expect inflation over the next year to be 4.3%, down from 4.7% in October, a three‑month low. Inflation expectations for the next 5‑10 years also fell from 3.5% to 3.4%.

Recent stock‑market volatility has affected households with the largest equity holdings differently. Joanne Hsu, director of the Michigan consumer survey, noted that confidence among respondents with less wealth and those with moderate wealth improved, while the group with the biggest stock positions saw consumer confidence drop 5% from the previous month.

That group’s assessment of their own financial situation fell another 12%, to the lowest level since April, likely linked to recent stock‑price swings. She also said that respondents’ answers indicate a growing number of people worried that the AI investment boom could turn into a bubble.

items.title: 輝達、AMD強彈！兩大利多帶動晶片股反攻 分析師提醒「繫好安全帶」
items.title_en: Nvidia, AMD Bounce Back! Two Tailwinds Drive Chip Stocks Rally, Analysts Urge “Fasten Your Seatbelts”
paras: 主要晶片股周五(6日)勁揚，自該類股六年來最慘烈的一波拋售潮中迎來強勢反彈。
美股開盤後不久，美光科技(MU-US) 、輝達(NVDA-US) 與英特爾(INTC-US) 股價紛紛大漲逾 5%，AMD(AMD-US) 漲幅更一度衝上 11%；此外，快閃記憶體大廠 SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 揚升 7%，博通(AVGO-US) 亦上漲 4%。
StoneX分析師Yi Fu Lee向《MarketWatch》表示，周四的「猛烈」拋售，讓AI相關晶片股周五浮現極為明顯的「強彈契機」。
他強調，iShares 費城半導體 ETF(SOX) 週四重挫 12%，相比之下，iShares 擴展科技與軟體行業 ETF(IGV-US) 雖同感壓力，但僅下跌 4%。
投行Stifel分析師Brian Chin將周五走勢形容為「劇烈震盪下的反向擺動」。他指出，晶片股雖然反彈，但未來資料中心支出的不確定性恐怕不會消退，可能使股價在一段時間內持續震盪。
不過，投資人仍可稍感安心的是，期中選舉後，市場對人工智慧的「根本需求」並未改變。他表示，只是監管這條路「變得更難走」。
在週四收盤後，監管面傳出兩項利多消息。首先是德州州長當選人希諾霍薩（Gina Hinojosa）釋出優於市場預期的正面訊號；她先前競選時曾主張對資料中心施加更嚴格的監管。
希諾霍薩於週四接受 CNN 專訪時坦言，自己並非要排斥資料中心，也非討厭資料中心，而是認為在確保德州民眾權益獲得完善保障前，必須先暫停相關措施。
另一項利多則來自《華爾街日報》報導，AI 獨角獸 Anthropic截至 10 月底的年化經常性收入（ARR）已突破 800 億美元，較 9 月底進一步成長。
不過，報導也指出，部分投資人認為該公司首次公開發行（IPO）的預估市值應從 1.5 兆美元下修。
整體而言，投資人宜對接下來的行情波動做好心理準備。Lee提醒，在「走勢極其劇烈且混亂的盤勢」中，切忌做出不理性的投資組合決策。
paras_en: Major chip stocks surged on Friday (the 6th), delivering a strong rebound after the most severe six‑year sell‑off in the sector.

Shortly after the U.S. market opened, Micron Technology (MU‑US), Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and Intel (INTC‑US) each jumped more than 5%, while AMD (AMD‑US) spiked up to 11%; flash‑memory maker SanDisk (SNDKV‑US) rose 7% and Broadcom (AVGO‑US) climbed 4%.
StoneX analyst Yi Fu Lee told MarketWatch that Thursday’s “ferocious” sell‑off created a very clear “bounce‑back opportunity” for AI‑related chip stocks on Friday.
He noted that the iShares Philadelphia Semiconductor ETF (SOX) plunged 12% on Thursday, whereas the iShares Expanded Technology & Software ETF (IGV‑US) also felt pressure but fell only 4%.

Stifel analyst Brian Chin described Friday’s move as a “reverse swing amid violent volatility.” He warned that although chip stocks have rebounded, lingering uncertainty over data‑center spending is unlikely to disappear and could keep prices volatile for some time.

Nevertheless, investors can take some comfort from the fact that, after the mid‑term elections, the market’s fundamental demand for artificial intelligence has not changed. He added that the regulatory path is simply becoming “harder to navigate.”

After Thursday’s close, two regulatory‑related tailwinds emerged. First, Texas governor‑elect Gina Hinojosa sent a more positive signal than the market expected; during her campaign she had advocated stricter regulation of data centers.

In a CNN interview on Thursday, Hinojosa said she is not opposed to data centers nor does she dislike them, but believes any measures must be paused until the rights of Texas residents are fully protected.
The second tailwind came from a Wall Street Journal report that AI unicorn Anthropic’s annualized recurring revenue (ARR) had topped $80 billion by the end of October, up from the end of September.
The article also noted that some investors think the company’s IPO valuation should be cut from the previously estimated $150 billion.
Overall, investors should brace themselves for further market swings. Lee cautioned that in “extremely volatile and chaotic trading conditions,” irrational portfolio decisions must be avoided.

items.title: 美國10月非農超預期！Fed下月升息機率約八成 美債殖利率為何衝高又回落？
items.title_en: U.S. October Nonfarm Payrolls Exceed Expectations; Fed’s Chance of a Rate Hike Next Month Around 80%; Why Treasury Yields Spiked Then Fell
paras: 美國10月非農就業人數增加16.5萬人，失業率降至4.1%，交易員估計聯準會(Fed)12月升息1碼的機率約八成。不過，就業報告出爐後，2年期美債殖利率一度上升7個基點至4.54%，漲幅隨即收斂。
華爾街策略師指出，強勁就業讓Fed有空間繼續對抗通膨，但若升息預期再度引發科技股賣壓，資金可能回流美債避險，反過來壓抑殖利率。

前兩月就業上修 失業率下降仍掩蓋部分就業不足

據《路透》報導，Savvy Wealth投資長Anshul Sharma認為，與10月就業數據本身同樣值得關注的，是8、9月新增就業人數合計上修8.4萬人。修正後，近三個月非農就業人數平均每月增加約13.7萬人，顯示企業徵才力道比市場原先估計更強。
Sharma特別點出，外界原先擔心AI會排擠白領工作，但專業與商業服務業就業人數過去一年持續成長，光是10月就增加7萬人。不過，想找全職工作卻只能兼職，或因雇主縮減工時而被迫兼職的人數，也增加33.9萬人。在他看來，勞動市場仍有未充分運用的人力，尚未出現過熱跡象。
對Fed而言，接下來的關鍵仍是通膨，尤其是能源價格。Annex Wealth Management首席經濟策略師Brian Jacobsen指出，平均時薪雖年增3.1%，漲幅仍追不上物價，實質購買力因而下降。若油價回落帶動汽油價格與通膨降溫，家庭負擔與Fed升息壓力都有望減輕。

升息押注推高美債殖利率 科技股若續跌恐吸引避險買盤

據《彭博》報導，周四大型科技股重挫，資金轉進美債，2年期美債殖利率一度跌破4.5%，10年期美債殖利率逼近4.80%，雙雙降至9月初以來低點。周五股指期貨反彈，殖利率在就業數據公布前已回升。報告出爐後，各天期美債殖利率先走高，隨後大致回到公布前水準，當日仍上升1至6個基點。
法盛北美美國利率策略主管John Briggs指出，債市反應相對溫和，因為交易員還在觀望股市如何消化這份報告。道明證券美國利率策略師Molly Brooks認為，若投資人把焦點轉回經濟表現，美債殖利率仍有上升空間。但若股市因擔心利率走高而再度下跌，避險買盤可能推升美債價格，限制殖利率升幅。
華爾街對Fed會如何權衡兩者仍有分歧。Spartan Capital Securities首席市場經濟學家Peter Cardillo認為，就業市場已接近充分就業，12月的問題在於升息1碼還是2碼。Themis Trading股票交易共同主管Joe Saluzzi則指出，就業數據固然支持升息，但若股市到決策時仍劇烈震盪，Fed是否願意進一步收緊政策，仍有變數。
paras_en: U.S. October nonfarm payrolls rose by 165,000 jobs, bringing the unemployment rate down to 4.1%, and traders estimate the probability of a one‑basis‑point Fed rate hike in December at roughly 80%. However, after the jobs report was released, the two‑year Treasury yield briefly jumped 7 basis points to 4.54% before the gain was quickly reined in.

Wall Street strategists note that the strong jobs data gives the Fed room to keep fighting inflation, but if the renewed rate‑hike expectations trigger a sell‑off in tech stocks, capital could flow back into Treasury bonds for safety, which would in turn push yields lower.

The upward revisions to the prior two months’ employment numbers and the drop in the unemployment rate still mask some underlying job shortfalls. According to Reuters, Savvy Wealth’s chief investment officer Anshul Sharma says the combined revision for August and September added 84,000 jobs. After the correction, the average monthly gain in nonfarm payrolls over the past three months is about 137,000, indicating that firms’ hiring strength is greater than the market originally thought.

Sharma points out that while there were earlier worries that AI might displace white‑collar workers, employment in professional and business services has continued to grow over the past year, adding 70,000 jobs in October alone. At the same time, the number of people who want full‑time work but can only find part‑time jobs, or who are forced into part‑time work because employers cut hours, rose by 339,000. In his view, the labor market still has under‑utilized capacity and shows no signs of overheating.

For the Fed, the key issue remains inflation, especially energy prices. Annex Wealth Management’s chief economic strategist Brian Jacobsen notes that while average hourly wages are up 3.1% year‑over‑year, the increase still lags behind price growth, eroding real purchasing power. If oil prices retreat and bring gasoline costs and overall inflation down, both household burdens and pressure on the Fed to raise rates could ease.

Rate‑hike bets have lifted Treasury yields, and a continued decline in tech stocks could attract more safe‑haven buying. Bloomberg reported that on Thursday large‑cap tech stocks slumped, prompting a shift of capital into Treasuries; the two‑year yield briefly fell below 4.5% while the ten‑year yield edged toward 4.80%, both hitting lows not seen since early September. Friday’s equity‑index futures rebounded and yields had already risen again before the jobs data were released. After the report, yields on various maturities rose initially and then largely returned to pre‑release levels, ending the day up 1 to 6 basis points.

John Briggs, head of U.S. rate strategy at Fairstone North America, said the bond market’s reaction was relatively muted because traders are still waiting to see how equities digest the report. TD Securities’ U.S. rate strategist Molly Brooks believes that if investors shift their focus back to economic performance, Treasury yields still have upside. However, if equities fall again over concerns about higher rates, defensive buying could lift Treasury prices and cap further yield gains.

Wall Street remains divided on how the Fed will balance the two forces. Peter Cardillo, chief market economist at Spartan Capital Securities, argues that the labor market is nearing full employment and the December question is whether the Fed raises rates by one or two basis points. Themis Trading’s co‑head of equities, Joe Saluzzi, adds that while the jobs data support a rate hike, a sharply volatile stock market at the time of the decision could still influence whether the Fed is willing to tighten policy further.

items.title: 美股才剛大跌 投行已看標普9000點「兩黨合作可能點燃追漲潮」
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Just Tumbled, Yet Investment Bank Sees S&P 9,000 Points – Bipartisan Cooperation Could Spark a Buying Frenzy
paras: 美股遭遇猛烈拋售，投行Evercore ISI卻提出樂觀情境：若美國兩黨在核心經濟議題上合作，加上聯準會抑制通膨，可能掀起投資人害怕錯過行情的「牛市狂潮」，推動標普500指數突破年底7750點目標，進一步朝9000點邁進。
美國期中選舉掀起「藍潮」，投資人重新評估人工智慧（AI）產業高速擴張面臨的政策風險。美股三大指數週四均創下2025年4月川普宣布「解放日」關稅政策以來最大單日跌幅，那斯達克指數更進入技術性修正區間。
不過，Evercore ISI首席股票暨量化策略師Julian Emanuel及其團隊認為，選後局勢未必只會走向兩黨對峙。若雙方能在部分核心經濟議題找到共同點，配合聯準會對抗通膨，市場可能迎來另一種走勢。
兩黨合作 有望重演1980年代行情
策略師指出，目前政治與貨幣政策的組合，讓人聯想到1980年代初期。當時，共和黨總統雷根、民主黨籍眾議院議長歐尼爾，以及強力對抗通膨的聯準會主席沃克，形成罕見的政策組合。
儘管三人政治理念差異甚大，美國經濟隨後仍進入新一輪擴張，股市也迎來長期上漲。如今，川普、即將出任眾議院議長的民主黨領袖傑弗里斯，以及聯準會主席沃什，也可能讓歷史重演。
Evercore ISI表示，兩黨合作與抑制通膨的歷史性機會就在眼前。若合作成真，可能引發害怕錯過機會的買盤，讓標普500指數突破該行年底7750點目標，朝9000點推進。這是以跨黨派合作為前提的樂觀情境。
川普釋善意 也握緊否決權
從選後表態來看，兩黨合作並非毫無可能。川普在選舉結果明朗後表示願意接受結果，向取得優勢的民主黨人道賀，並稱期待雙方為「國家利益」合作。
他也表示，將看看能達成哪些協議，並提及雙方可能在債務上限等議題找到共同點。
不過，川普同時強調自己擁有「完全的否決權」，也歡迎外界稱他為「否決先生」。他認為，行使否決權可迫使民主黨回到談判桌，促成跨黨派協議。
關稅與伊朗戰爭成潛在突破口
分析指出，貿易政策是最可能出現妥協的領域之一。民主黨雖反對川普大規模動用關稅，卻不完全排斥以關稅保護美國製造業與就業。雙方未來可能取消部分爭議較大的關稅，同時保留針對特定國家及產業的保護措施。
伊朗戰爭也是潛在突破口。高盛經濟學家預期，民主黨掌控國會後，可能透過預算及立法權限制戰爭，並推動取消部分關稅，也可能尋求恢復先前遭刪減的社會福利與醫療支出。
看好極樂觀情境 仍不建議全面追高
針對上述極度樂觀的情境，Evercore ISI並未建議投資人直接追高整體市場，而是提出考慮買進與那斯達克100指數ETF QQQ連結、明年3月或6月到期的輕度價外買權。
該行提及的選擇權規格為「25 delta」，履約價約較當時市價高出7%至10%，作為參與這種樂觀行情的方式。
paras_en: U.S. equities faced a fierce sell‑off, but investment bank Evercore ISI outlined an optimistic scenario: if the two major parties in Washington cooperate on core economic issues and the Federal Reserve continues to curb inflation, investors fearing they might miss a rally could spark a "bull market frenzy," pushing the S&P 500 past its year‑end target of 7,750 points and onward toward 9,000.

The midterm elections generated a "blue wave," prompting investors to reassess policy risks to the rapid expansion of the artificial‑intelligence sector. All three major U.S. indexes posted their biggest single‑day declines since President Trump announced the "Liberation Day" tariff policy in April 2025, with the Nasdaq slipping into a technical correction zone.

Evercore ISI’s chief equity and quantitative strategist Julian Emanuel and his team, however, argue that the post‑election landscape may not simply devolve into partisan deadlock. If the parties can find common ground on some key economic issues and work with the Fed to fight inflation, the market could follow a different trajectory.
Bipartisan cooperation could echo the market dynamics of the 1980s.

The strategists note that today’s mix of political and monetary policy resembles the early 1980s, when Republican President Reagan, Democratic Speaker of the House O’Neill, and a Fed chaired by Paul Volcker formed a rare policy coalition.

Despite their divergent political philosophies, the U.S. economy entered a new expansionary phase and the stock market enjoyed a prolonged rally. Now, with Trump, the incoming Democratic House Speaker Jeffries, and Fed Chair Waller, a similar historical repeat may be possible.

Evercore ISI says the historic chance of bipartisan cooperation combined with inflation control is imminent. If it materializes, fear‑of‑missing‑out buying could lift the S&P 500 past the firm’s year‑end target of 7,750 and push it toward 9,000 – an optimistic outlook predicated on cross‑party collaboration.
Trump Shows Goodwill Yet Holds Veto Power

Post‑election statements suggest bipartisan cooperation is not out of reach. After the results clarified, Trump said he would accept the outcome, congratulated the victorious Democrats, and expressed hope for cooperation in the "national interest."
He added that he would see what agreements could be reached and mentioned that the parties might find common ground on issues such as the debt ceiling.

However, Trump also stressed that he retains "full veto power" and welcomed being dubbed "Mr. Veto," arguing that exercising that power could force Democrats back to the negotiating table and enable bipartisan deals.
Tariffs and the Iran war are potential breakthrough areas

Analysts point out that trade policy is one of the most likely areas for compromise. While Democrats oppose Trump’s large‑scale tariff use, they are not wholly against tariffs that protect U.S. manufacturing and jobs, leaving room for both sides to roll back the most contentious duties while keeping protections for specific countries and sectors.

The Iran conflict is another possible opening. Goldman Sachs economists expect that, with Democrats controlling Congress, they may use budget and legislative authority to limit the war, roll back some tariffs, and seek to restore previously cut social‑welfare and health‑care spending.
Optimistic scenario is appealing but does not warrant a full market chase

Regarding this highly optimistic scenario, Evercore ISI does not advise investors to simply buy the market at elevated levels; instead, it suggests considering purchases linked to the Nasdaq‑100 ETF QQQ, specifically lightly out‑of‑the‑money call options expiring in March or June of next year.
The option specifications mentioned are "25 delta" contracts with strike prices roughly 7% to 10% above the prevailing market price, offered as a way to participate in this optimistic market move.

items.title: Google母公司買進高通！持股價值近5.48億美元
items.title_en: Alphabet, Google’s Parent, Buys Qualcomm Shares Worth About $548 Million
paras: 據《路透》報導，Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)第三季買進長期合作夥伴高通(QCOM-US)的股票，所持股份價值近5.48億美元。在智慧型手機市場陷入多年來最嚴重的低迷期之一之際，高通正加快拓展AI資料中心晶片業務，預期到2029年，該業務營收將達150億美元。
高通股價周五(6日)盤前上漲3%。前一日，由於截至9月底的季度財報表現不如預期，加上美國期中選舉後美股湧現賣壓，高通股價重挫逾9%。
Alphabet與高通的合作可追溯至Android手機。多年來，幾乎所有主要Android手機品牌都採用過高通晶片。Google近期推出的高階筆電系列Googlebook也搭載高通處理器。兩家公司還在2024年達成協議，共同開發車用晶片與軟體，推動AI技術應用於汽車。
如今，高通希望把業務版圖從手機擴大到資料中心。過去一年，高通積極向雲端服務商推銷客製化AI處理器，瞄準兩類需求：一是科技業者希望自行設計晶片，二是尋找輝達(NVDA-US)高價晶片以外的選擇。
高通今年9月與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)達成協議，亞馬遜依約最多可採購600億美元的高通AI資料中心晶片及相關產品。高通也向亞馬遜發行認股權證，讓亞馬遜有權買進高通股票。微軟(MSFT-US)與Meta(META-US)則已下單採購高通的資料中心處理器。
除揭露高通持股外，Alphabet周五也公布，對馬斯克旗下SpaceX(SPCX-US)的持股從先前的5.512億股小幅增至約5.55億股。
paras_en: According to Reuters, Alphabet (GOOGL‑US, GOOG‑US), Google’s parent company, purchased shares of its long‑time partner Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) in the third quarter, bringing the value of its holding to nearly $548 million. As the smartphone market sinks into one of its deepest downturns in years, Qualcomm is accelerating its expansion into AI data‑center chips, with revenue from that business expected to reach $15 billion by 2029.

Qualcomm’s stock rose 3% in pre‑market trading on Friday the 6th. The day before, the shares had tumbled more than 9% after the company’s Q3 earnings through September fell short of expectations and U.S. equities faced selling pressure following the mid‑term elections.

Alphabet’s partnership with Qualcomm dates back to Android phones. For many years, virtually every major Android handset has used Qualcomm chips. Google’s recently launched high‑end laptop line, Googlebook, also runs on Qualcomm processors. In 2024 the two firms struck a deal to co‑develop automotive chips and software, pushing AI applications into cars.

Now Qualcomm aims to broaden its business beyond phones into data centers. Over the past year it has actively pitched custom AI processors to cloud providers, targeting two types of demand: tech companies that want to design their own chips and customers seeking alternatives to Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) high‑priced offerings.

In September, Qualcomm signed an agreement with Amazon (AMZN‑US) that allows Amazon to purchase up to $60 billion of Qualcomm AI data‑center chips and related products. Qualcomm also issued warrants to Amazon, giving it the right to buy Qualcomm stock. Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Meta (META‑US) have already placed orders for Qualcomm’s data‑center processors.

In addition to disclosing its Qualcomm stake, Alphabet on Friday also announced a slight increase in its holding of Elon Musk’s SpaceX (SPCX‑US), rising from 551.2 million shares to about 555 million shares.

items.title: 世芯-KY(3661) 第3季 EPS 37.68 元創新高！毛利率跌破 20%，獲利為何照樣創高？
items.title_en: WorldChip-KY (3661) Q3 EPS Hits Record High of NT$37.68; Gross Margin Falls Below 20% Yet Profit Still Peaks
paras: 世芯-KY(3661-TW)第3季營收 8.193 億美元、季增 238.9%、年增 267%，稅後淨利 1.02 億美元首度突破 1 億美元，EPS 37.68 元創歷史新高；同一季毛利率降到低於 20%，公司形容已接近業務組合的最差情境。
N3 加速器量產出貨董事長暨執行長 Johnny Shen 表示，這顆晶片「上季順利進入大量生產」，符合所有測試標準、良率也合理，預期當前世代將維持生產約兩年。
營收組合因此被單一產品拉走：HPC 佔營收 87%，北美地區由第2季的 51% 跳到 84%，3 奈米與 2 奈米製程合計由 47% 拉到 80%。營業利益 1.139 億美元、季增 118.7%、年增 194.1%。
毛利率兩季掉 30 個百分點營收組合被拉走的同時，毛利率也一路往下。依優分析產業資料庫的財報資料，世芯毛利率 2026 年第 1 季還有 50.18%、第 2 季 34.84%，第 3 季落到 20% 以下，低於 2024 年第 1 季的 18.79%，是 2022 年以來最低。
毛利率下滑的兩個原因，公司都講明了：量產營收占比拉高、少數專案 NRE 營收認列延遲。財務長 Daniel 指出，毛利率降到低於 20%，主要是量產營收占比很高、第 3 季 NRE 營收貢獻略低於預期；董事長 Johnny Shen 形容，這樣的營收組合使毛利率大幅降至低於 20%。會議中分析師引述的數字是 18%。
營業利益率只溫和下降。以營業利益 1.139 億美元、營收 8.193 億美元計算約 13.9%，公司的解釋是營運槓桿：銷售規模擴大之後，商業模式的槓桿效果會愈來愈高。
第4季營收再創新高推升第4季的是量產營收提高與重大設計案投片活動；毛利率「第3季和第4季會相當接近」。全年合併毛利率，公司仍以超過 20% 為目標。
根據優分析產業資料庫，把營收、毛利率與營業利益率疊在同一張圖上，看的是 2021 年以後那一組反向走勢：毛利率從五成降到三成上下，營業利益率反而往上墊（季度資料到 2026 年第 2 季，第 3 季財報還沒進資料庫）。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)
N3 專案的營收貢獻，第4季預期略高於第3季，2027 年則明顯高於 2026 年。
第3季的獲利是規模撐出來的：營收與 EPS 都創高，毛利率落到公司口中的最差情境，營業利益率只剩 13.9%。NRE 什麼時候回升，公司沒有給時間表。

paras_en: WorldChip-KY (3661‑TW) posted Q3 revenue of US$819.3 million, up 238.9% quarter‑over‑quarter and 267% year‑over‑year, with net profit after tax reaching US$102 million for the first time to break the US$100 million mark. EPS climbed to NT$37.68, a historic high, while gross margin slipped below 20%, which the company says reflects a near‑worst‑case product mix scenario.

Chairman and CEO Johnny Shen said the N3 accelerator entered mass production smoothly last quarter, meeting all test standards with reasonable yields, and that the current generation is expected to stay in production for about two years.

Revenue was pulled by a single product: HPC accounted for 87% of revenue, with North America’s share jumping from 51% in Q2 to 84% in Q3, and the combined 3‑nm and 2‑nm processes rising from 47% to 80%. Operating profit was US$113.9 million, up 118.7% quarter‑over‑quarter and 194.1% year‑over‑year.

While the revenue mix was dominated by one product, gross margin fell sharply for two consecutive quarters. According to Youshan Industry Database’s financial data, WorldChip’s gross margin was projected at 50.18% in Q1 2026, 34.84% in Q2 2026, and dropped below 20% in Q3 2026—lower than the 18.79% recorded in Q1 2024 and the lowest since 2022.

The company cited two reasons for the margin decline: a higher share of mass‑production revenue and delayed recognition of a few NRE project revenues. CFO Daniel noted that the margin fell below 20% mainly because mass‑production revenue dominated and Q3 NRE revenue was slightly below expectations; Chairman Shen described the revenue mix as driving the margin down to below 20%, with analysts quoting a figure of 18% in the meeting.

Operating margin only declined modestly. With operating profit of US$113.9 million on revenue of US$819.3 million, the margin is about 13.9%. The company attributes this to operating leverage: as sales scale expands, the leverage effect of the business model increases.

Q4 revenue is expected to set a new high, driven by higher mass‑production revenue and major design‑win wafer‑submission activities; gross margin for Q3 and Q4 is expected to be “quite close.” For the full year, the consolidated gross margin target remains above 20%.

According to Youshan Industry Database, overlaying revenue, gross margin and operating margin on the same chart shows a reverse trend since 2021: gross margin fell from around 50% to the low‑30% range, while operating margin actually rose (quarterly data up to Q2 2026; Q3 2026 financials are not yet in the database).
(Source: Youshan Industry Database)
Revenue contribution from the N3 project is expected to be slightly higher in Q4 than in Q3, and to be markedly higher in 2027 than in 2026.

Q3 profit was driven by scale: both revenue and EPS reached new highs, gross margin fell to what the company calls its worst‑case scenario, and operating margin was left at only 13.9%. The timing of an NRE rebound was not provided by the company.

items.title: 世芯-KY(3661) 美系新客戶預估貢獻 10 億美元！明年約第2季起貢獻，2027 年三位數成長
items.title_en: WorldChip‑KY (3661) US New Customer Estimated to Contribute $1 Billion! Contributions Starting Around Q2 Next Year, Triple‑Digit Growth by 2027
paras: 世芯-KY(3661-TW)在第3季法說會宣布拿下一個全新客戶的設計案，合約已簽、專案已啟動，預期貢獻約 10 億美元營收，明年、約第 2 季開始貢獻，2027 年成為第2大營收貢獻來源。
美系全新客戶約明年第2季放量公司表示：新客戶是美商，並明確排除中國客戶；對世芯來說是完全新客戶；這筆生意直接與終端客戶往來，沒有其他方參與。就營收 10 億美元貢獻規模來看，這項業務一定來自市場上的大咖之一。
公司表示，這筆是生產營收，不是 NRE；從明年第2季某個時間點開始，第2季延續到第3季、第4季，逐季線性增加。規模只給一個級別：10 億美元。
分析師追問 2028 年年化會不會到 15 億至 20 億美元，公司沒有順著這個問法回答。Johnny Shen 強調這是新商業模式的起點，著眼與這個客戶的長期合作，預期之後還會有更多專案。
2027 三位數成長2027 年的三位數成長有兩層：既有 N3 加速器專案本身就三位數成長，加上新客戶的貢獻，整體會比 N3 的步調更好。Daniel 表示，今年與明年的總營收某種程度仍由 N3 主導，明年 N3 的營收貢獻預期三位數成長。
根據優分析產業資料庫，法人對 2027 年以後的營收預估在 2026 年 10 月之後同步上修：2027 年約 1,300 億元、2028 年跳到 1,500 億元以上，2029、2030 年再各上一階。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)
管理層表示：分析師假設的明年 40 億至 50 億美元，「根據我們目前展望可以達成」，但不會保證實際數字。
這筆 10 億美元案在 2027 年多一個大客戶，也把世芯推到能與終端客戶談長期合作的位置。規模、時程、排名都由公司給定：明年約第 2 季起逐季放量、2027 年成為第2大來源。這是世芯第一次把生產營收與終端客戶綁在同一張合約上。

paras_en: WorldChip‑KY (3661‑TW) announced at its Q3 earnings briefing that it has secured a brand‑new customer design project. The contract is signed and the project has started, and it is expected to generate about $1 billion in revenue, beginning around the second quarter of next year and becoming the company’s second‑largest revenue source by 2027.

The new customer is a U.S.‑based firm, explicitly excluding any Chinese customers. For WorldChip this is a completely new client, and the business will be conducted directly with the end‑user without any intermediaries. Given the $1 billion revenue impact, the deal must involve one of the market’s major players.

The company clarified that the $1 billion figure represents production revenue, not NRE (non‑recurring engineering) income. Starting at some point in Q2 next year, the revenue will ramp up linearly each quarter through Q3 and Q4. The scale is simply described as a $1 billion level.

When analysts asked whether the annualized revenue could reach $1.5‑$2 billion by 2028, the company did not answer that specific question. Johnny Shen emphasized that this marks the start of a new business model and that the long‑term partnership with the customer is expected to generate additional projects in the future.

Triple‑digit growth in 2027 comes from two sources: the existing N3 accelerator projects, which are already growing at triple‑digit rates, and the contribution from the new customer, which will push overall growth beyond the N3 pace. Daniel noted that this year’s and next year’s total revenue will still be largely driven by N3, with N3 revenue itself projected to grow at a triple‑digit rate next year.

According to data from the U‑Analysis industry database, institutional forecasts for revenue after 2027 were revised upward after October 2026: about NT$130 billion for 2027, jumping to over NT$150 billion in 2028, with further step‑ups in 2029 and 2030.
(Source: U‑Analysis industry database)
Management said that analysts’ assumption of $4‑$5 billion next year is “achievable based on our current outlook,” though they do not guarantee the actual figure.

The $1 billion deal adds a major client in 2027 and positions WorldChip to negotiate long‑term agreements directly with the end‑user. The company set the scale, timeline, and ranking: volume will increase each quarter starting around Q2 next year, and by 2027 it will become the second‑largest revenue source. This is WorldChip’s first time tying production revenue to an end‑customer in a single contract.

items.title: 世芯-KY(3661) 2028 年營收再跳一級！公司表示瓶頸在資產負債表
items.title_en: WorldChip-KY (3661) 2028 Revenue Set to Jump Again! Company Says Bottleneck Lies in Balance Sheet
paras: 世芯-KY(3661-TW)把 2028 年的成長寄託在下一代 N2 加速器上。執行長 Johnny Shen 表示，這一代的規模會比 N3 大得多、晶圓下單情況也會好得多；被問到 2028 年能不能再翻倍，他的回答分成兩句：「營收成長不再是問題」，真正的限制是「我們的資產負債表能承載多少營收」。
N2 只由兩方對台積電下單N2 專案目前唯一實體設計供應商是世芯，客戶承諾至少目前只會有兩方對台積電下單：客戶與世芯。I/O die 同樣由世芯負責，公司表示目前沒看到任何其他參與者，這顆晶片也沒有第三方 IP 依賴。
設計難度比 N3 高一階：N3 是 SoC、2.5D 封裝，N2 是 chiplet 加 GAA 製程，世芯負責每一個部分的實體設計再組合起來。專案本季開始一系列投片，目標明年第4季進入原型與小量生產，2028 年放量。
根據優分析產業資料庫，法人平均預估的營收與 EPS 在 2026 年之後同步往上，2030 年的營收共識約 2,400 億元；這組數字是 2026 年 10 月 12 日的版本，還沒把法說會宣布的新客戶算進去。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)
N3 這一代，世芯是從競爭對手手上贏回專案，當時有同業不做設計卻取得生產權。台積電的魏哲家在自家法說會上說不喜歡次級晶圓市場，Johnny Shen 回應「這對我們是非常好的消息」。他認為透過貢獻設計能力，應該也值得享有生產帶來的利益。
人力年底衝 4 位數，接案更挑資源是另一個限制。Johnny Shen 表示現在幾乎滿檔，最近積極招聘，到今年底有機會達到 4 位數人力。人力補上來之前，公司只能挑案子，不是每個都接：一年 1 億至 2 億美元的 CPU、網通專案仍會支持，但加速器業務一年可能做到 30 億、40 億、60 億美元，相較之下 1 到 2 億美元在財務上不顯著。
零組件短缺主要壓在較小專案。公司估計，第3季若沒有晶圓、載板或封裝產能限制，營收可以再增加 1 億美元；加速器屬於供應商優先支持的業務，受影響很小。
長期營業利益率目標接近 20%公司給了一個算法：營收 40 億美元、毛利率 20%，營業費用壓在 2 億美元以內，營業利益率就是 15%；要靠規模與保守的費用紀律才走得上去。第3季毛利率低於 20%、營業利益率約 13.9%，離那個目標還有一段。
公司認為 2028 年的瓶頸在於資產負債表能承載多少營收，另一邊是 N2 的時程，目標明年第4季做出原型、2028 年放量。人力與供應鏈的限制今年已經出現，到那一年還在。

paras_en: WorldChip-KY (3661-TW) is pinning its 2028 growth on the next‑generation N2 accelerator. CEO Johnny Shen said this generation will be much larger than N3 and wafer orders will be far better; when asked if revenue could double again in 2028, he answered in two parts: “Revenue growth will no longer be an issue,” and the real constraint is “how much revenue our balance sheet can support.”

N2 orders come only from two parties to TSMC. The only physical design supplier for the N2 project is WorldChip, and the customer has pledged that, for now, only two parties will place orders with TSMC: the customer and WorldChip. The I/O die is also handled by WorldChip, and the company sees no other participants; the chip has no third‑party IP dependencies.

The design difficulty is one level higher than N3: N3 is a SoC with 2.5D packaging, while N2 is a chiplet using GAA process, with WorldChip responsible for every physical design piece and their integration. The project started a series of tape‑outs this quarter, aiming for a prototype and low‑volume production in Q4 next year, with volume production in 2028.

According to the Youfenxi industry database, institutional investors’ average forecasts for revenue and EPS rise in tandem after 2026, with a consensus revenue of about NT$240 billion for 2030. These figures are from the October 12 2026 version and do not yet include the new customers announced at the earnings conference.
(Source: Youfenxi industry database)

For the N3 generation, WorldChip won the project back from a competitor that had obtained production rights without doing the design. TSMC’s Wei Zhe‑Jia said at his own earnings call that he dislikes the secondary wafer market, to which Johnny Shen replied, “That’s very good news for us.” He believes that contributing design capability should also entitle the company to share the benefits of production.

Headcount will surge into four‑digits by year‑end, and project selection becomes another limitation due to resource constraints. Johnny Shen said the team is almost fully booked, recruitment is aggressive, and by the end of the year they may reach a four‑digit headcount. Until staffing catches up, the company can only pick projects, not take every one: CPU and networking projects worth $100‑200 million a year will still be supported, but accelerator business could reach $3‑4‑6 billion annually, making $100‑200 million relatively insignificant financially.

Component shortages mainly affect smaller projects. The company estimates that if there are no wafer, substrate or packaging capacity constraints in Q3, revenue could increase by another $100 million; accelerator business, being a priority for suppliers, is barely affected.

The long‑term operating margin target is close to 20%. The company gave a simple calculation: with $4 billion revenue and a 20% gross margin, keeping operating expenses under $200 million yields a 15% operating margin; achieving this requires scale and disciplined cost control. In Q3 gross margin fell below 20% and operating margin was about 13.9%, still short of the goal.

The company believes the 2028 bottleneck is how much revenue the balance sheet can bear, while the N2 schedule targets a prototype in Q4 next year and volume production in 2028. Human‑resource and supply‑chain constraints have already appeared this year and will persist until then.

items.title: 世芯-KY(3661) 沒有產能限制的話，上季營收可以再多 1 億美元！
items.title_en: WorldChip-KY (3661) Could Have Added $100 Million in Revenue Last Quarter Without Capacity Constraints!
paras: 世芯-KY(3661-TW)第3季營收 8.193 億美元創高，公司表示若沒有晶圓、載板與封裝的產能限制，上季可以「輕易再創造 1 億美元營收」；短缺主要壓在加速器以外的小專案。
晶圓、載板、封裝短缺董事長暨執行長 Johnny Shen 表示，數個量產專案受到晶圓、載板或封裝產能短缺影響，「如果沒有這項限制，我們相信上季可以輕易再創造 1 億美元營收」。
短缺主要發生在其他客戶身上，問題出在封裝與載板。公司認為：供應商會選擇支持大專案或大客戶。因為供應商非常聚焦 CSP 業務，那是他們的優先事項；車用、消費這些市場區隔開始受到影響。
短缺對 N3 加速器較無影響公司表示，加速器專案享有供應商相當大的特權，「對加速器而言，我不會說完全沒有影響，但影響真的非常小」；加速器業務長期都是所有供應商的優先項目。
這波短缺讓世芯上季少做 1 億美元，掉的是加速器以外的小案；加速器本身仍排在供應商名單前面，公司的產能地位沒有跟著掉。
但從存貨來看，世芯自己手上的案子仍照進度投片。根據優分析產業資料庫，存貨從 2024 年第 4 季的 57.5 億元一路墊高，2026 年第 2 季來到 240 億元，增加的部分主要是「在製品」，也就是晶圓投下去之後、還沒變成成品的那一段過程。

paras_en: WorldChip-KY (3661-TW) posted third‑quarter revenue of $819.3 million, a record high. The company says that if there were no capacity limits on wafers, substrates and packaging, it could have easily generated an additional $100 million last quarter; the shortage mainly affected small projects outside of accelerators.

Chairman and CEO Johnny Shen explained that several mass‑production projects were hit by wafer, substrate or packaging capacity shortages, and “if this limitation didn’t exist, we believe we could have easily created another $100 million in revenue last quarter.”

The shortages mainly occurred for other customers and stem from packaging and substrates. The company believes suppliers choose to support large projects or major customers. Because suppliers are heavily focused on CSP business, that is their priority; automotive and consumer market segments are beginning to feel the impact.

The shortage has little impact on the N3 accelerator, the company said. Accelerator projects enjoy considerable privilege from suppliers, “I wouldn’t say there’s no impact at all, but the impact is truly minimal.” Accelerator business has long been a top priority for all suppliers.

This wave of shortage caused WorldChip to miss $100 million last quarter, which came from small projects outside of accelerators; accelerators themselves remain at the top of the supplier list, and the company’s capacity position has not slipped.

However, looking at inventory, WorldChip’s own projects are still progressing on schedule. According to the You Analysis industry database, inventory rose from NT$5.75 billion in Q4 2024 to NT$24 billion in Q2 2026, with the increase mainly in work‑in‑process items—that is, wafers that have been processed but not yet turned into finished products.

items.title_en: WorldChip-KY (3661) Plans Four‑Digit Workforce by Year‑End; Company Says Current Issue Is Inability to Take On More Projects
paras: 世芯-KY(3661-TW)第3季營收創高之後，執行長 Johnny Shen 把限制講得很清楚：資源短缺是最大的問題之一，現在幾乎滿檔，最近積極招聘，到今年底有機會達到 4 位數人力。
公司開始挑案Johnny Shen 表示，CPU 與網通專案目前都按進度走，是好客戶、好專案，一年能貢獻超過 1 億美元營收；但加速器業務一年可能做到 30 億、40 億、60 億美元，相較之下 1 到 2 億美元在財務上不顯著。
他表示，那些客戶還是會繼續支持，但人力滿檔，接一個案就佔掉一組人，公司只能挑案子，不是每個都接。
公司將繼續補充人員一個專案的人力現在集中在最後階段。Johnny Shen 表示，以前完成一個完整專案大約需要 150 人，現在 150 人是尖峰時期，中間階段可以省下很多資源。
節省發生在前期與分析：客戶跑 coding 多半從 AI 生成的內容起頭；跑完工具會產出幾十份報告，以前要資深工程師讀，現在 AI 能過濾變異、指出下一步該看哪裡。
限制也很明確。N2、A14 這些製程太新，世芯沒有足夠參考資料訓練模型，只能在專案早期自己做訓練。到了最終實作階段，AI 幫不上太多，仍然需要大量資源。
公司的目標是今年底有機會達到 4 位數，這樣才能承接多得多的專案。
短期內世芯能接多少專案，取決於人補得多快；需求那一端，公司表示仍然強勁。
根據優分析產業資料庫，法人平均預估的營收在 2027 年之後一路往上，2030 年約 2,400 億元。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)

paras_en: After third‑quarter revenue hit a record high, CEO Johnny Shen made the constraints crystal clear: resource shortage is one of the biggest problems, the company is almost at full capacity, and recent aggressive hiring could bring the workforce to a four‑digit headcount by the end of the year.

The company has started to be selective about projects. Shen said CPU and networking projects are progressing on schedule, are good customers and good projects, and can generate over US$100 million in revenue per year; however, accelerator business could reach US$3‑4‑6 billion annually, making the US$1‑2 billion from the former financially insignificant in comparison.

He added that those customers will still support the firm, but with manpower at capacity, taking on a single project consumes an entire team, so the company can only pick projects and cannot accept every one.

The firm will continue to add staff; project staffing is now concentrated in the final stage. Shen noted that completing a full project used to require about 150 people, and now 150 is only the peak, with many resources saved during the middle phases.

Savings occur in the early and analysis stages: customers run coding mostly starting from AI‑generated content; after running tools, dozens of reports are produced, which previously required senior engineers to read, but now AI can filter anomalies and point out where to look next.

The constraints are also clear. Processes like N2 and A14 are too new; WorldChip lacks sufficient reference data to train models, so it must train them in‑house during early project phases. By the final implementation stage, AI offers little help and substantial resources are still needed.
The company’s goal is to reach a four‑digit headcount by year‑end, which is necessary to take on many more projects.
In the short term, how many projects WorldChip can accept depends on how quickly it can add staff; on the demand side, the company says the market remains strong.
According to the Youfenxi industry database, institutional analysts’ average revenue forecasts keep rising after 2027, reaching about NT$240 billion by 2030.
(Source: Youfenxi industry database)

items.title: 世芯-KY(3661) N3 是從競爭對手手上贏回來的！次級晶圓市場若收斂，對世芯絕對是好消息
items.title_en: WorldChip-KY (3661) N3 Won Back from Competitors! If the Sub‑Tier Wafer Market Consolidates, It’s Definitely Good News for WorldChip
paras: 世芯-KY(3661-TW)的 N3 專案是從競爭對手手上贏回來的。法說會上有分析師點出，有同業不做設計卻能拿到專案的生產權；台積電的魏哲家在自家法說會上說不喜歡次級晶圓市場，世芯執行長 Johnny Shen 回應，次級市場若能緩解，對世芯絕對是好消息。
這一代的代價：贏下專案，先解決營運資金N3 專案的生意規模非常大，世芯當初的優先目標是贏，當時可能沒有足夠的營運資金支撐這個專案，幾個月前發了 GDR 才把大部分限制解開。
公司表示，客戶關係愈來愈緊密，客戶對世芯的依賴提高，因為世芯在當前專案提供價值，明年因此從客戶接到更多訂單。Johnny Shen 認為，透過貢獻設計能力，應該也值得享有生產帶來的利益。
下一代：兩方下單是前提，次級市場與條件都還沒定下一代的情況不同。N2 專案目前唯一實體設計供應商是世芯，客戶承諾至少目前只會有兩方對台積電下單：客戶與世芯。I/O die 也由世芯負責，公司表示目前沒有看到其他參與者，這顆晶片沒有第三方 IP 依賴。
這個結構要接的量，法人已經先畫出來了。根據優分析產業資料庫，法人平均預估的營收在 2028 年之後明顯變陡，2030 年約 2,400 億元。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)
台積電對次級晶圓市場的態度，是這條線的關鍵變數。魏哲家說不喜歡次級晶圓市場，Johnny Shen 直接把這句話接成公司的期待：如果次級市場能在某種程度上緩解，對世芯絕對是好消息。
第四代條件還沒談完。公司給的進度是：比前一代好得多、還沒完全完成、設計還沒 tape out。

paras_en: WorldChip‑KY (3661‑TW) won back the N3 project from a competitor. During the earnings briefing, an analyst noted that some peers, despite not doing design work, secured production rights to the project; TSMC’s Wei Zhe‑Jia said at his own briefing that he dislikes the sub‑tier wafer market, and WorldChip CEO Johnny Shen replied that if the sub‑tier market eases, it would be great news for WorldChip.

The cost of this generation: winning the project first required solving operating‑capital needs. The N3 project is very large in scale; WorldChip’s initial priority was to win it, even though it may not have had enough operating capital to support the project at the time. A few months ago it issued GDRs, which lifted most of the constraints.

The company says customer relationships are becoming increasingly close, and customer reliance on WorldChip is rising because WorldChip is delivering value in the current project. Consequently, it expects to receive more orders from the customer next year. Johnny Shen believes that by contributing design capability, WorldChip should also share in the profits generated by production.

Next generation: both parties placing orders is a prerequisite, and the sub‑tier market and its conditions have not yet been set, which differs from the next‑gen situation. For the N2 project, WorldChip is currently the only physical design supplier, and the customer has pledged that, at least for now, only two parties will place orders with TSMC: the customer and WorldChip. The I/O die is also handled by WorldChip, and the company says it sees no other participants; this chip has no third‑party IP dependencies.

The volume this structure will handle has already been sketched out by institutional investors. According to the Youfenxi industry database, the average revenue forecast from institutions shows a sharp increase after 2028, reaching about NT$240 billion by 2030.
Source: Youfenxi industry database

TSMC’s attitude toward the sub‑tier wafer market is a key variable on this line. Wei Zhe‑Jia said he dislikes the sub‑tier wafer market, and Johnny Shen directly turned that comment into the company’s expectation: if the sub‑tier market can be alleviated to some extent, it would be great news for WorldChip.

The fourth‑generation conditions have not yet been fully discussed. The company’s timeline indicates it is much better than the previous generation, still not fully completed, and the design has not yet been tape‑out.

items.title: 世芯-KY(3661) 有信心贏下 Google！執行長：商業模式還沒定，不賺錢的設計不接
items.title_en: WorldChip-KY (3661) Confident It Can Win Over Google! CEO: Business Model Not Yet Set, Won’t Take Unprofitable Designs
paras: 世芯-KY(3661-TW)法說會上，執行長 Johnny Shen 被問到 Google TPU 的機會時說：「Google 一直是我們想贏下的目標」，「我們非常非常樂觀，也非常有信心能贏下這個客戶」；合作模式與時間點，公司都沒有給。
有信心，但模式沒定、不賺錢的不接至於會是設計的一部分，還是類似聯發科在 TPU v8、v9 那樣的協調者角色，Johnny Shen 表示，對這樣層級的客戶有各種商業模式，公司會嘗試每一種可能的合作方式，現在無法說明會是哪一種。
同一段對話裡他補了一個前提：如果任何設計活動不能產生任何營收，就不會接。這與公司今年的接案紀律一致：人力幾乎滿檔，年底才可能補到 4 位數，接案得挑。
Google 的案子多到可以分，這次的大客戶不是它他表示，Google 有非常多不同專案、不同 SKU，能服務的供應商只有少數幾家；遲早贏下 Google 不會覺得特別，每個人都會有機會服務 Google。這段話的重點在需求端的結構：專案數量夠多，新供應商才有切入的位置。
這些都還沒進預估。根據優分析產業資料庫，法人平均預估的營收 2030 年約 2,400 億元，最新預估日期是 2026 年 10 月 12 日，Google 與新客戶都還沒算進去。
(資料來源：優分析產業資料庫)
法說會上另一個大案子是 10 億美元級的新客戶，與 Google 是兩件事。公司表示新客戶直接往來、沒有其他方參與，是美系、對世芯全新的客戶；用途方面，公司表示以這樣的量體和營收，「一定得是 AI」。
公司對 Google 的表態停在「有信心」：沒有合約、沒有時間表，也沒有講定用哪一種商業模式合作。

paras_en: At WorldChip-KY’s (3661‑TW) earnings briefing, CEO Johnny Shen was asked about the opportunity with Google’s TPU and said, “Google has always been a target we want to win,” adding, “We are extremely optimistic and very confident we can win this customer.” The company gave no details on the cooperation model or timeline.

He said the company is confident, but the model is not decided and it will not take on designs that do not generate profit. Whether it will be part of the design effort or act like MediaTek did with TPU v8 and v9 as a coordinator, Johnny Shen noted that for a client of this caliber there are many possible business models, and the company will try every feasible cooperation method, though it cannot now specify which one it will be.

In the same exchange he added a premise: any design activity that cannot generate revenue will not be taken. This aligns with the company’s project‑acceptance discipline this year: manpower is almost fully booked, and only in the year‑end might they add a four‑digit headcount, so they must be selective about projects.

Google’s projects are so numerous they could be split into categories. This large client is not the only one, he said; Google has many different projects and SKUs, and only a few suppliers can serve them. Winning Google eventually will not be seen as special, as everyone will have a chance to serve Google. The point is the demand‑side structure: with enough projects, new suppliers can find entry points.

These figures have not yet been included in forecasts. According to the U-Analysis industry database, institutional investors on average project revenue of about NT$240 billion by 2030, with the latest estimate dated October 12 2026, and neither Google nor new customers are yet accounted for.
(Source: U‑Analysis industry database)

Another major deal discussed at the briefing is a new customer worth about US$1 billion, separate from Google. The company said the new client deals directly with it, with no third parties involved, is a U.S.‑based firm and a completely new customer for WorldChip. Regarding usage, the company indicated that with such volume and revenue, “it must be AI.”
The company’s stance on Google stops at “confident”: there is no contract, no timetable, and no defined business model for cooperation.

items.title: 台積電要做AI記憶體？傳應輝達要求研擬生產3D DRAM
items.title_en: TSMC to Develop AI Memory? Reports Say Nvidia Requests 3D DRAM Production Plan
paras: 據外媒引述《The Information》周五(7日)報導，應最大客戶輝達(NVDA-US)要求，台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)近期已著手研擬3D DRAM生產計畫。知情人士透露，台積電正評估兩種方案，包括新建晶圓廠，或收購既有廠房改造為記憶體生產線。計畫仍在研擬階段，投產時程尚未明朗。
報導指出，這項計畫由台積電先進封裝技術發展副總經理徐國晉主導。徐國晉曾任台灣美光董事長，目前負責台積電三維積體電路(3D IC)與先進封裝等系統整合技術的開發。台積電與輝達均未立即回應置評請求。
動態隨機存取記憶體(DRAM)用來暫存裝置運作時所需的資料。傳統DRAM的記憶單元排列在同一平面，3D DRAM則將記憶單元垂直堆疊，以提高儲存容量。若台積電投入生產，將在先進記憶體市場與三星電子(005930-KS)、SK海力士(000660-KS)(SKHY-US)及美光(MU-US)競爭。
輝達尋求更多供應來源，背後是AI硬體需求激增，導致記憶體晶片嚴重短缺、價格飆升。成本壓力也已波及消費電子產品。蘋果(AAPL-US)同樣在尋找更多記憶體供應來源，今年稍早調高部分產品售價時，就曾將記憶體成本上升列為原因之一。
paras_en: According to foreign media citing The Information on Friday (the 7th), TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) has recently begun drafting a production plan for 3D DRAM at the request of its biggest customer, Nvidia (NVDA‑US). Insiders say TSMC is evaluating two options: building a new fab or acquiring an existing plant and converting it into a memory production line. The plan is still in the study phase, and a timeline for production has not been set.

The report notes that the project is led by TSMC’s Vice President of Advanced Packaging Technology Development, Hsu Kuo‑chin. Hsu, a former chairman of Micron Taiwan, now oversees the development of 3D IC and advanced packaging system‑integration technologies at TSMC. Neither TSMC nor Nvidia responded to requests for comment.

Dynamic random‑access memory (DRAM) is used to temporarily store data needed during device operation. Traditional DRAM stores memory cells on a single plane, while 3D DRAM stacks the cells vertically to increase capacity. If TSMC enters production, it would compete in the advanced memory market with Samsung Electronics (005930‑KS), SK Hynix (000660‑KS, SKHY‑US) and Micron (MU‑US).

Nvidia is seeking additional supply sources amid a surge in AI hardware demand that has caused a severe shortage of memory chips and soaring prices. The cost pressure has also spilled over into consumer electronics. Apple (AAPL‑US) is likewise looking for more memory suppliers and earlier this year cited rising memory costs as one reason for raising prices on some products.

items.title: 輝達哪些AI晶片還能賣中國？美國會擬設「落後兩代」門檻 H200剛好踩線
items.title_en: Which Nvidia AI Chips Can Still Be Sold to China? U.S. May Set a “Two‑Generation Lag” Threshold, H200 Hits the Line
paras: 據《彭博》周五(6日)報導，美國國會兩黨正協商一項提案，擬維持現行AI晶片出口限制18個月，期間中國只能取得至少落後美國最先進產品兩個世代的技術。輝達(NVDA-US)已獲准銷往中國的H200，恰好比最新的Rubin系列落後兩代。明年1月民主黨接掌國會後，執行長黃仁勳還可能面對另一道問題：輝達如何確認賣給海外客戶的晶片，最終沒有被轉運到中國？

H200獲准銷中 實際銷量低於核准數量

川普政府於2025年底允許輝達向中國銷售H200，但取得美方許可只是第一關。輝達今年8月向投資人證實，由於北京當局反對，公司僅向中國客戶售出少量H200，實際銷量低於美方核准的數量。
這批許可如何核發，也已引起國會關注。民主黨參議員華倫與眾議院外交委員會民主黨首席議員米克斯，已要求川普政府提供相關資料。華倫也多次要求黃仁勳赴國會說明輝達的中國業務。她是下屆參議院銀行委員會主席熱門人選，若接掌這個負責監督出口管制的委員會，將更有權力要求黃仁勳出席作證。
立法進度可能比國會換屆更快。華倫與共和黨參議員班克斯正爭取在明年1月3日新國會就職前，將上述《AI監督法案》納入國防法案。若獲通過，國會將對AI晶片銷中有更大的監督權。「落後兩代」是提案要維持的技術門檻，個別產品能否出貨，仍涉及出口許可。

晶片賣到東南亞之後 國會擬要求查驗流向

另一項仍在協商的《晶片安全法案》，則把監管重點放在交貨之後。依最新公開版本，美國商務部可決定如何驗證出口至海外的AI資料中心晶片是否遭轉運，例如透過訊號回傳確認晶片位置，或派員到現場清點庫存。
《彭博》引述知情人士指出，輝達已加強追蹤銷往東南亞的AI加速器。新加坡客戶Megaspeed便是一例。三名共和黨籍眾院委員會主席日前要求黃仁勳說明他與該公司一名高層的往來。黃仁勳上周接受《彭博》訪問時表示，輝達已查核Megaspeed部署GPU的情況，逐一清點後，確認該客戶未違法將晶片運往中國。
兩項提案目前都在協商。對輝達而言，前者關係到未來哪些產品還有機會取得對中出口許可，後者則可能使晶片流向查驗成為海外出貨必須符合的要求。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg on Friday the 6th, bipartisan members of the U.S. Congress are negotiating a proposal to keep the current AI chip export restrictions in place for 18 months, during which China would be allowed to obtain only technology that is at least two generations behind the United States' most advanced products. Nvidia (NVDA-US) has been approved to sell its H200 to China, which happens to be two generations behind the latest Rubin series. After Democrats take control of Congress in January, CEO Jensen Huang may face another issue: how Nvidia can ensure that chips sold to overseas customers are not ultimately re‑exported to China.

The Trump administration allowed Nvidia to sell the H200 to China through the end of 2025, but obtaining U.S. permission was only the first hurdle. In August, Nvidia told investors that, because Beijing objected, the company sold only a small number of H200 units to Chinese customers, with actual shipments falling short of the amount approved by the U.S. government.

How the permits were issued has already drawn congressional attention. Democratic Senator Warren and House Foreign Affairs Committee Democratic ranking member Mick Mulvaney have asked the Trump administration for the relevant documentation. Warren has repeatedly called on Jensen Huang to appear before Congress to explain Nvidia’s China business. She is a leading candidate to chair the Senate Banking Committee, which oversees export controls, and would have greater authority to demand Huang’s testimony if she assumes that role.

Legislative progress could outpace the congressional turnover. Warren and Republican Senator Mike Braun are pushing to embed the proposed “AI Oversight Act” into the defense authorization bill before the new Congress is sworn in on Jan. 3. If passed, Congress would gain broader oversight of AI chip sales to China. The “two‑generation lag” is the technical threshold the bill seeks to maintain, while individual product shipments would still require export licenses.

Another bill under negotiation, the “Chip Security Act,” focuses on post‑delivery monitoring. The latest public draft gives the Commerce Department authority to verify whether AI data‑center chips exported abroad are being re‑routed, for example by using signal‑back checks on chip location or by sending personnel to inventory on‑site.

Bloomberg, citing sources, reported that Nvidia has stepped up tracking of AI accelerators shipped to Southeast Asia. Singapore customer Megaspeed is one example. Three Republican chairs of House committees recently asked Jensen Huang to explain his interactions with a senior executive at the firm. Huang told Bloomberg last week that Nvidia has audited Megaspeed’s GPU deployments, counted the units one by one, and confirmed the customer has not illegally shipped the chips to China.

Both proposals are still being negotiated. For Nvidia, the first determines which future products may still qualify for export licenses to China, while the second could make verification of chip destinations a mandatory condition for any overseas shipment.

items.title: AI股若繼續跌 Fed還會升息嗎？「Fed傳聲筒」點出12月關鍵
items.title_en: If AI Stocks Keep Falling, Will the Fed Still Raise Rates? The “Fed Mouthpiece” Highlights a Key December Factor
paras: 聯準會(Fed)12月是否再升息，AI股這波修正可能比剛公布的非農就業數據更值得關注。有「Fed傳聲筒」之稱的《華爾街日報》(WSJ)記者Nick Timiraos周五(6日)分析，近期經濟數據與官員談話仍指向12月再度升息，但若AI股賣壓持續，進一步拖累消費與企業投資，金融市場本身就可能產生部分升息原本要達到的緊縮效果。

AI股跌多久 為什麼跌 都會影響Fed判斷

Timiraos指出，自10月中旬開始的AI股賣壓，在周四(5日)科技股重挫後加深。投資人重新評估AI相關企業的獲利前景，原因之一是晶片、電力等資源短缺，成本上升的速度超過企業向客戶轉嫁的速度，利潤因而受到擠壓。
對Fed而言，跌幅只是判斷的一部分。即使股價短時間內大跌，只要市場很快回穩，官員也可能不會改變利率看法。但若投資人開始懷疑，企業投入的龐大AI支出能否創造足以支撐估值的回報，這波修正就可能持續更久，影響也會從股市延伸到實體經濟。
股價持續下跌，可能削弱家庭財富對消費的支撐。企業若也重新評估AI投資的回報，原本帶動經濟成長的資本支出便可能放慢。在這種情況下，即使Fed維持利率不變，金融環境也已收緊，進一步升息以抑制需求的必要性就會降低。

華許重視市場訊號 下周CPI是決策前最後一份

這也是Timiraos認為市場走勢可能比單月非農數字更重要的原因。Fed主席華許重視金融市場對經濟前景的判斷，對仰賴反映過去狀況的月度統計來決定利率則抱持疑慮。他上任前就曾提醒，政府數據公布有時間落差，事後也經常修正，過度強調「依據數據決策」有其風險。
眼下，12月升息仍是較受支持的方向。Fed在9月升息後，10月將基準利率維持在3.75%至4%，理事庫克與克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克當時都投票支持再升息。會後也有多名官員表示，利率可能仍需逐步調高。10月就業報告大致印證官員原先的判斷：勞動市場供需大致平衡，通膨卻仍高於2%目標。
接下來最值得留意的時間點是11月10日。當天公布的10月消費者物價指數(CPI)，將是Fed在12月8日至9日開會前能看到的最後一份CPI，因為11月數據要到利率決議出爐隔天才公布。屆時官員手上還會多一份就業報告，但在Timiraos看來，物價壓力是否持續，以及AI股修正是否已收緊金融環境，才更可能左右12月的決定。
paras_en: The question of whether the Federal Reserve will raise rates again in December is perhaps more noteworthy than the just‑released non‑farm payroll data, given the ongoing correction in AI stocks. WSJ reporter Nick Timiraos, known as the “Fed mouthpiece,” wrote on Friday (the 6th) that recent economic data and officials’ remarks still point to another December hike, but if AI‑stock selling pressure persists and drags down consumer spending and corporate investment, the financial markets themselves could generate part of the tightening effect that a rate hike is meant to achieve.

Timiraos notes that the AI‑stock sell‑off, which began in mid‑October, deepened after a sharp drop in tech stocks on Thursday (the 5th). Investors are re‑evaluating the profit outlook for AI‑related firms, partly because shortages of chips, electricity and other resources are driving cost increases faster than companies can pass them on to customers, squeezing margins.

For the Fed, the market decline is only one piece of the puzzle. Even if stock prices tumble sharply in the short term, officials may not change their rate view as long as the market stabilises quickly. However, if investors start doubting whether the massive AI spending by companies can generate returns sufficient to justify current valuations, the correction could linger and its impact could spread from the equity market to the real economy.

Continued price declines could erode household wealth support for consumption. If firms also reassess the returns on AI investments, capital spending that had been fueling growth could slow. In that scenario, even if the Fed leaves rates unchanged, the financial environment would already be tighter, reducing the need for further hikes to curb demand.

Timiraos believes market dynamics may matter more than a single month’s payroll numbers. Fed Chair Jerome Powell places great weight on financial‑market signals about the economy’s outlook and is skeptical of relying solely on monthly statistics that reflect past conditions. Before taking office, Powell warned that government data are released with a lag and are often revised, so over‑reliance on “data‑driven” decisions carries risk.

At present, a December rate hike remains the more likely path. After raising rates in September, the Fed kept the target range at 3.75%‑4% in October, with Board members Cook and Cleveland Fed President Mester voting in favor of another increase. Several officials later said rates may still need to be raised gradually. The October jobs report broadly confirmed their view: labor‑market supply and demand were roughly balanced, but inflation stayed above the 2% target.

The most important date to watch is November 10, when the October Consumer Price Index will be released. It will be the last CPI reading the Fed sees before its meeting on December 8‑9, because November’s data won’t be published until the day after the rate decision. Officials will also have an employment report at that time, but Timiraos argues that whether price pressures persist and whether the AI‑stock correction has already tightened financial conditions are more likely to shape the December decision.

items.title: 莫德納上修全年營收展望海外新冠疫苗需求帶動第三季轉盈
items.title_en: Moderna Raises Full-Year Revenue Outlook as Overseas COVID Vaccine Demand Drives Q3 Profitability
paras: 2026年11月07日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 莫德納(MRNA-US)11月6日上修2026年營收成長展望，由原先最多成長10%，提高至15%至25%。海外新冠疫苗交付增加，帶動第三季營收年增29%至約13億美元，並由去年同期虧損2億美元轉為獲利1億6200萬美元，稀釋後每股盈餘0.38美元。
海外市場是本季成長主力。莫德納表示，英國、加拿大及澳洲等長期政府合作協議支持疫苗交付，第三季美國營收7億8000萬美元、國際市場5億3300萬美元；全年營收仍預期由美國與海外市場各占約一半。公司9月另與墨西哥當地製造商簽訂五年新冠疫苗合作協議，持續擴大海外市場。
費用下降也有助獲利改善。第三季研發費用年減27%至5億8300萬美元，主要因部分傳染病疫苗後期試驗完成或逐步結束，以及營運效率提升。莫德納將全年研發費用預估由29億美元降至27億美元；諾羅病毒疫苗第三期試驗期中分析未達提前成功的統計標準，公司不打算在本次流行季新增試驗群組，將與衛生主管機關討論後續方向。
在新冠疫苗以外，莫德納的流感疫苗已於8月獲美國核准，但因錯過年度採購簽約期，2026至2027流感季僅有限度推出。與默沙東共同開發的個人化癌症疫苗intismeran，第三期黑色素瘤試驗顯示，搭配Keytruda相較單用Keytruda，可降低復發或死亡風險42%。兩家公司正準備申請核准與商業化，能否上市仍須取得主管機關同意。

paras_en: On November 6, Moderna (MRNA-US) upgraded its 2026 revenue growth outlook, increasing the potential increase from a maximum of 10% to a range of 15%‑25%. Higher overseas COVID‑19 vaccine deliveries boosted third‑quarter revenue by 29% year‑over‑year to about $1.3 billion, turning a loss of $200 million in the same period last year into a profit of $162 million, or diluted earnings of $0.38 per share.

Overseas markets were the main driver of growth this quarter. Moderna said long‑term government agreements in the United Kingdom, Canada and Australia support vaccine deliveries, with Q3 U.S. revenue of $780 million and international revenue of $533 million; the company still expects full‑year revenue to be roughly split half‑and‑half between the United States and overseas markets. In September the firm also signed a five‑year COVID‑19 vaccine partnership with a Mexican manufacturer to continue expanding its overseas presence.

Lower expenses also helped improve profitability. Q3 research‑and‑development spending fell 27% year‑over‑year to $583 million, mainly because late‑stage trials for some infectious‑disease vaccines were completed or winding down, and operational efficiency improved. Moderna now projects full‑year R&D costs to drop from $2.9 billion to $2.7 billion; an interim analysis of the Phase III Norovirus vaccine trial did not meet the pre‑specified statistical success criteria, and the company does not plan to add new trial arms this flu season, pending discussions with health regulators on next steps.

Beyond COVID‑19, Moderna’s flu vaccine received U.S. approval in August, but missing the annual procurement signing window means it will be rolled out only in a limited fashion for the 2026‑2027 flu season. The personalized cancer vaccine intismeran, co‑developed with Merck, showed in a Phase III melanoma study that, when combined with Keytruda, it reduced the risk of recurrence or death by 42% compared with Keytruda alone. The two companies are preparing regulatory filings and commercialization plans, though market launch still requires regulatory approval.
